headline.note: All four runs evaluated at the SAME round endpoint (epoch 50). clean = ep50 endpoint network (deterministic, 69/71, >97%). noisy = 3 chips at ep50 (68/71, 68/71, 67/71 = two >95%, one >94%), each under its fixed device-mismatch + read-noise condition, identical in training and inference. Reproducible by re-running with the same seeds.

recipe.network: 34-input, 5-hidden, 2-output NMOS input-output fully-connected network (147 edges), gate-to-drain, floating body, no supply rail (driven by the 34 input sources)
recipe.read_noise: Gaussian sigma = 0.5% of the input full-scale, on every measurement (training and inference)
recipe.mismatch: 1x: per-device VTO offset sigma=10 mV + drive-strength (kp) sigma=0.5%; free and clamp independently mismatched

noisy.note: each chip = a fixed 1x device-mismatch fingerprint + read noise; deployed (free-phase) test accuracy at ep50
